name: zammad
label: Zammad
description: Open-source helpdesk: read tickets with their conversation, reply internally or to the customer, set state, escalate. Woken by trigger webhooks.

versions.notes: Was compiled into Covey up to 0.5.0. Same actions; COVEY_ZAMMAD_REPLY_TYPE is now the reply_type parameter, and the group allowlist belongs in the Zammad trigger.
